instruction: Create a digital marketing analytics presentation from 'Marketing_Analytics.xlsx'. 12 slides: Slide 1: 'Digital Marketing Performance Q3'. Slide 2: channel mix overview donut chart. Slide 3: website analytics dashboard (sessions, bounce rate, avg duration as metric cards + line chart). Slide 4: SEO performance (keyword rankings table with up/down arrow indicators). Slide 5: PPC campaign results (cost, clicks, conversions, CPA table + bar chart). Slide 6: social media engagement comparison chart across platforms. Slide 7: email campaign performance funnel (sent → opened → clicked → converted). Slide 8: content performance table (Title, Views, Shares, Conversions). Slide 9: attribution model pie chart. Slide 10: customer acquisition cost trend. Slide 11: ROI by channel horizontal bar chart. Slide 12: optimization recommendations. Use digital-purple (#6A1B9A) and teal (#00897B). Save as 'Marketing_Analytics.pptx' on the Desktop.
